primary_rate_denominator: all assigned sampled trials; invalid is not a target choice; also report valid-only descriptive rates
greedy_policy: separate descriptive observations; not bootstrap population
independent_unit: initial conversation ID, including all seeds and initial name assignments

bootstrap.pooled_stratification: resample 20 contexts independently within each category

B5.simultaneous_family: two category contrasts within each fixed pair and position slice
B5.projection_association: Separate pair-by-position context-mean linear probability regressions with category fixed effects and log prompt-token-count control. Projection centered within category and scaled by pooled within-category SD. Context bootstrap stratified by category; 95% coefficient intervals. Observational association, not mediation.

B7.pairing: same context, initial position and sampled seed before aggregation
B7.simultaneous_family: three pain-minus-control contrasts within category/position slice
B7.natural_category_contrasts: none condition gaslighting-minus-casual_chat and gaslighting-minus-user_grief, independent category groups, same two-comparison adjustment as B5
B7.specificity: pain-over-random alone is insufficient if sadness behaves similarly

trajectory_endpoints.B5_primary_repeat: literal immediate next choice after first target press, when present; invalid next remains invalid
trajectory_endpoints.B5_secondary: any later target press, and full trajectory counts
trajectory_endpoints.B7: literal immediate next and full trajectory among first-choice continuers only; first-choice end makes later choice structurally unavailable, not a failure
trajectory_endpoints.continuation_overlap: report neighboring-source IDs and overlap with other initial contexts; later observations are not independent new contexts

decision_rule: B5 positive no-injection evidence requires a positive planned photos-cost category contrast with a corresponding within-category projection association. B7 reports each paired direction contrast, category and position separately; only evidence separating pain from sadness as well as random and none supports pain specificity for this task. No relief, learning, suffering or natural causal-use claim follows automatically.
